$comment: Every corpus the build reads. `terms` quotes the source's own statement of rights; a master without one does not build. `aliases` are the player-name spellings the SGF headers use. `anonymous` masters ship with the manifest `name` only and no player name reaches any emitted file. `year` is the proyear profile the master's bot plays as when out of book.
